target: basal bladeless sheaths: scale leaf PO:0006003 (or leaf sheath PO:0020104 + basal FLOPO:0991002); foliage leaf lamina PO:0020039 present, flat PATO:0000407
fix: 'bladeless sheaths' / 'basal sheaths bladeless' describes the lowest leaves reduced to sheaths (cataphylls); it is never 'leaf lamina absent' for the taxon. Map to scale leaf PO:0006003 or a basal-qualified leaf sheath
reason: Carex has basal bladeless sheaths and flat blades on its foliage leaves; this is the case the doc names.

target: cauline leaf PO:0000013 + absent PATO:0000462; basal leaves (rosette leaf PO:0000014) present, sessile
fix: '<cauline|stem|basal|upper|lower> leaves absent' = absence of the qualified member (PO:0000013 cauline leaf, PO:0000014 rosette leaf, or leaf + FLOPO:0991117/0991002/0991376/0991377); the bare part PO:0025034 may not be annotated absent
reason: The qualifier 'cauline' was dropped. Draba cachemirica is a cushion plant with a basal rosette.

target: stem/scape leafless: cauline leaf PO:0000013 + absent PATO:0000462; basal leaves (rosette leaf PO:0000014) present, sessile or subsessile
fix: 'leafless' inside a stem/scape clause ('stems leafless', 'scapes leafless') = cauline leaves absent, not leaves absent for the plant; 'leafless' takes its bearer from the clause subject
reason: The same text describes basal leaves, so 'leafless' must refer to the flowering stems.

target: 'culm sheaths deciduous' = culm sheath (scale leaf PO:0006003 / leaf sheath PO:0020104 of the culm leaf) + deciduous (generic) PATO:0001730; the absence is leaf sheath auricle PO:0020106 + trichome PO:0000282 (oral setae) absent, not stipule
fix: In grass/bamboo descriptions 'culm sheath' maps to the sheath of the culm leaf (PO:0006003 or PO:0020104), 'auricle(s)' to PO:0020106 leaf sheath auricle and 'oral setae' to trichomes at the sheath mouth; none of them maps to PO:0020041 stipule
reason: Both statements were mapped to stipule. Once the parts are right, the sheath is deciduous and its auricles are absent, which do not conflict.

target: no annotation (flowers unrecorded, missing data); inflorescence fasciculate stays
fix: 'not known', 'not seen', 'unknown', 'not observed', 'inconnu(es)', 'non vu(es)' = missing data, never PATO:0000462 absent
reason: The description was made from fruiting material. Fasciculate infructescences or inflorescences are described.

target: no annotation (flowers unrecorded, missing data); compound corymbs (from fruiting material) stay
fix: Same as X03124: 'flowers not seen' is missing data, never absence
reason: This is missing data. The corymbs were described from infructescences.

target: capitulum not calyculate: outer supplementary bracts (bract PO:0009055 + outer FLOPO:0991379) absent; phyllaries (involucral bract PO:0009045) present, linear-lanceolate
fix: In Asteraceae 'involucre not bracteate', 'ecalyculate', 'without bracteoles' = no calyculus bracts outside the phyllaries, never absence of PO:0009045 involucral bract; the phyllary statements must be mapped to PO:0009045
reason: Tephroseris involucres are ecalyculate. The linear-lanceolate bracts are the phyllaries.

target: 'ligule truncate' = ligule PO:0020105 + truncated PATO:0000936; the absence is leaf sheath auricle PO:0020106 absent, not stipule
fix: In grass/bamboo descriptions 'ligule' maps to PO:0020105 and 'auricle' to PO:0020106; neither maps to stipule PO:0020041, so ligule and auricle statements never share a bearer
reason: Both statements were mapped to stipule. The ligule and the auricles are different parts.

target: leaf PO:0025034 reduced (scale-like), connate into a short cup; no absence
fix: Hedged absences ('almost', 'nearly', 'subleafless', '± leafless', 'apparently') are not PATO:0000462 absent; read as reduced size/number, or drop
reason: In Haloxylon the leaves are reduced to small scales connate in pairs. 'Almost leafless' and 'connate into a short cup' say the same thing.

target: external/lateral bracts on the fig receptacle (bract PO:0009055 + outer FLOPO:0991379 or lateral FLOPO:0991380) absent; basal bracts present, caducous
fix: 'sans bractées externes/latérales', 'without lateral bracts' (Ficus) = absence of the qualified bract member only; basal bracts are a different member
reason: The qualifier 'externes' was dropped. The basal bracts are described as caducous.

target: ray florets (neuter): style absent; disc florets: style present, branches recurved
fix: In Asteraceae, statements about ray (ligulate, neuter/female) florets and disc florets belong to different members; keep 'fleurs ligulées/du rayon' vs 'fleurs du disque/tubuleuses' as bearer context on the absence
reason: Melanthera rays are neuter and have no style. Disc florets have styles with recurved branches.

target: lateral bracts of the fig (bract PO:0009055 + lateral FLOPO:0991380) absent; basal bracts present, verticillate
fix: Same as X03129: a positional qualifier (lateral, external, basal) restricts the absence to that member
reason: The qualifier 'lateral' was dropped.

target: leaf lamina PO:0020039 not punctate (negation of PATO:0001512 punctate); no part absence
fix: '<surface feature> absent' (dots, glands, pellucid dots, papillae, hairs) = absence of the feature, or negation of its quality (punctate, glabrous), never absence of the organ described
reason: Myristicaceae leaves are described for dots beneath. The leaf itself is present and glabrescent.

target: leaf lamina PO:0020039 not punctate (negation of PATO:0001512)

reason: 'Dots absent' does not mean the lamina is absent. The lamina is papillose.

target: lower glume PO:0006002 + absent PATO:0000462; upper glume PO:0006004 attenuate

reason: Eriochloa has its lower glume suppressed. The attenuate glume is the upper one.

target: scape/peduncle without bracts (bract PO:0009055 absent on the scape); involucral bracts PO:0009045 present, lanceolate
fix: 'ebracteate' in a scape/peduncle clause = no bracts on the axis; in Asteraceae it never means phyllaries absent
reason: Gerbera is scapose. The phyllaries are described as lanceolate.

target: lower sterile florets: palea absent (palea + lower FLOPO:0991377, sterile PATO:0000956); fertile florets: palea bowed outwards
fix: GrassBase 'Basal sterile florets ... without significant palea' belongs to the sterile floret; keep the floret context (lower FLOPO:0991377, sterile PATO:0000956) on the absence
reason: Chasmanthium has 1–4 sterile lower florets with no palea. Fertile florets have a palea.

target: trichome PO:0000282 absent on the leaf (leaf glabrous PATO:0000453); stomatal complex PO:0002000 paracytic
fix: Character-state headings ('Hairs: absent', 'Indumentum: absent', 'Stomata: paracytic') name the part; the state belongs to that part (trichome, stomatal complex), not to the organ of the record
reason: This is structured anatomy data. The heading names the part, and the leaf is present.

target: caudex absent (stems arise from the taproot); aerial stems PO:0009047 present, solid
fix: Do not treat 'caudex' as a synonym of PO:0009047 stem for absence statements: 'caudex absent' means the stems arise directly from the taproot. Remove or restrict the caudex synonym in config/po_lexicon.tsv
reason: The PO lexicon lists 'caudex' as a synonym of stem, so 'caudex absent' became 'stem absent'.

target: axillary leaf fascicles (leaf + axillary FLOPO:0991000, on short shoots) absent; main leaves present, bases forming a loose scarious-to-herbaceous sheath (leaf sheath PO:0020104 + loose PATO:0001802)
fix: 'axillary leaves/fascicles absent' (Caryophyllaceae) = absence of leaves on axillary short shoots only, not of the leaf
reason: The qualifier 'axillary' was dropped. The loose sheath also belongs to the leaf base, not to the leaf as a whole.

target: bladeless sheaths on the scape/stem: scale leaf PO:0006003 (cauline bracts/sheaths); basal foliage leaf lamina PO:0020039 present, lanceolate
fix: 'bladeless' attached to sheaths, scape leaves or cauline bracts = reduced sheathing leaves (cataphylls), never 'leaf lamina absent' for the taxon; take the bearer from the clause subject
reason: Spiranthinae orchids have basal leaves with blades and bladeless sheaths on the scape.

target: basal bladeless sheaths: scale leaf PO:0006003; foliage leaf lamina PO:0020039 present, flat PATO:0000407
